description: Traffico Giornaliero Medio - Rete stradale ed autostradale ANAS is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Valori del traffico giornaliero medio della rete stradale ed autostradale italiana di interesse nazionale gestiti da ANAS, aggiornati al Novembre 2015 rilevati dalle postazioni della Piattaforma ANAS per il Monitoraggio e l'Analisi PANAMA (. Coverage: Italy. The portal files it under the publisher Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Its tags are minf, tgm. It offers 2 resource(s) in JSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
